description: EODHD (End of Day Historical Data) provides financial market data APIs covering stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, forex, crypto, and indices. It offers end-of-day historical prices, real-time and delayed quotes, fundamentals, dividends, splits, options, and economic data via REST endpoints. Developers authenticate with an API key and can access data for portfolio tracking, backtesting, research, and fintech applications.
